resources.string: PC Status client for this phone
The client reads CPU and GPU usage the way adb shell can, so it runs with root or through this phone\'s own wireless debugging (no root needed).
Wireless debugging: pair this app first
Wireless debugging is off (or the phone is not on Wi-Fi)
This Android has no wireless debugging. Run `adb tcpip 5555` once from a PC (again after every restart).
1. Developer options → Wireless debugging: turn it on\n2. Tap “Pair device with pairing code”\n3. Type the 6-digit code into this app’s notification
Wireless debugging needs Wi-Fi. The first time on each network, allow it on that network (“Always allow”).
Open “Pair device with pairing code” and type the code here
pcsc-rs can use wireless debugging now
The phone has to be on a Wi-Fi network where wireless debugging was allowed. The app turns wireless debugging on to start the client and back off.
